nzta.title: NZTA VIN layouts
nzta.scope: Official NZTA diagrams; pre/post 29 November 2009. The layouts are published only as two images, VIN-pic-1.jpg and VIN-pic-2.jpg; the page text states no character position. Every position meaning recorded here is a reading of those two pictures, transcribed box by box in the stored copy. The stored copy also carries NZTA's own statement of the length and character set, from VIRM 1-1 VIN and chassis number, which is what the decoder validates against.
nzta.retrieval_note: The live site refuses automated requests (HTTP 403), so the images were retrieved through the Internet Archive. They are byte-identical in the captures of 2025-02-12 and 2026-02-21: VIN-pic-1.jpg sha256 e2ded28ca9332eada6dabc1ef8b1af8d6816cd54e429fe8fcce6928cd899ed9a, VIN-pic-2.jpg sha256 ed4c983e03cc734d3d37915efbe8066b21d967e603f73eb34fdd69915afed365.

nzta_virm_attributes.title: NZTA VIRM, entry certification 2-2 Vehicle attributes definitions (Table 2-2-1)
nzta_virm_attributes.scope: Table 2-2-1, LANDATA-defined vehicle types: the 14 two-digit codes and the type each denotes. LANDATA is the system that assigns a 7A8/7AT VIN, and this code is what such a VIN carries at positions 8-9.

segments.note: LANDATA model lookup unavailable; 6L must not be split into a model-year digit and batch letter.

values.05: Trailers not designed for normal highway use[1]
values.06: Mobile machines not designed for normal highway use[1]
values.23: Agricultural tractors capable of more than 50km/h

segments.note: The positions come from NZTA's pre-2009 VIN diagram, which prints 07 in this slot and captions it "NZTA vehicle type code"; the code meanings come from VIRM 2-2 Table 2-2-1, quoted verbatim including its superscript note markers. Only the pre-2009 layout has this slot: the post-2009 layout replaces it with the meaningless X at position 9. The register records its own wording for 13 of these codes in registries/nz.json registry_vehicle_types, keyed by the spelling the register emits; code 23 has no register spelling recorded there, and no correspondence between the two spellings is asserted here.
Two-digit assignment year only; not registration/manufacture year; century unresolved.

profiles.note: The make box in NZTA's pre-2009 diagram holds two characters, "DH", while the caption beneath it reads "0DH denotes Nissan" -- the three-character form the post-2009 diagram uses. The box and its own caption disagree, and the box is the layout, so DH is recorded for positions 4-5. The discrepancy is the source's, and is carried here rather than resolved silently.

unconstrained_fields.description: Fields NZTA prints without stating any format rule. Recorded so the absence of a check is deliberate and attributable: the decoder reads these as written and enforces nothing, because a rule the publisher never stated would reject VINs the register may legitimately carry.
unconstrained_fields.vin_assignment_year_code: NZTA prints "Year the VIN assigned" with the examples 01 and 09, and states no rule that the code is numeric.
unconstrained_fields.serial_component: NZTA prints "Number derived from the last six digits of the OE chassis number or randomly derived if no chassis number or VIN already exists", with the example 123456, and states no rule that the result is numeric.
unconstrained_fields.note: What the source does state is enforced, and only that: NZTA writes that a valid VIN "consists of 17 characters that never contain the letters I, O or Q" (VIRM 1-1 VIN and chassis number), and diagram 2 prints "No meaning always X" at position 9.

profiles.note: The registration authority assigns this VIN itself, so its characters carry no manufacturer variant and no production year. Declared here rather than in code so that a register whose authority assigns VINs under a different prefix, or not at all, states its own.
